subject: Short pilot onboarding — invoice-only / temporary no-PO request (LatticeWorks)
messages:
From: Evan Shaw <evan@latticeworks.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: LatticeWorks Procurement <procure@latticeworks.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Request: short-term onboarding & PO exception for LatticeWorks pilot

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at LatticeWorks is excited to kick off a three-week pilot next Tuesday. Procurement asked me to confirm onboarding requirements. We can get you a signed SOW (attached) and a W-9, but our legal requires the vendor onboarding system to create a PO for ongoing work and that typically takes 2–3 weeks on our side.

Because this pilot is time-sensitive, can Redwood accept invoices without a PO for the pilot period (one-off invoices totaling $12,500) and route them to finance? If needed we can provide a short mutual action plan and escalate on our side.

Attachments: latticeworks_sow_pilot.pdf (SOW), latticeworks_w9.pdf (W-9)

Goal: invoice-only intake for pilot + agreement to create PO if we move to production.

Appreciate a quick confirmation — Evan
Evan Shaw
Head of Integrations, LatticeWorks
evan@latticeworks.io
+1 415-555-0183

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Shaw <evan@latticeworks.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term onboarding & PO exception for LatticeWorks pilot

Hi Evan — thanks for sending the SOW and W-9. This is a common ask for time-boxed pilots.

Internal note: looping in Karthik (sales) and Priya (finance/ops) to review a temporary invoice-only onboarding.

Quick answers for your team:
- We can accept invoice(s) without a PO for the pilot provided the total is <= $15k and we receive the W-9 + signed SOW.
- Condition: Redwood requires invoices be addressed to procurement-invoices@redwood.com and include the SOW ID and the pilot dates.
- We will initiate vendor setup today and will create a PO if we move to an expanded engagement.

Priya / Karthik — can finance approve an exception for LatticeWorks for this pilot? Please confirm any additional evidence you need.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
Senior Sales Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.ai

From: Evan Shaw <evan@latticeworks.io>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>
Cc: LatticeWorks Procurement <procure@latticeworks.io>
Date: Wed, 20 Jun 2028 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: short-term onboarding & PO exception for LatticeWorks pilot

Hi Naomi — perfect, that aligns with our timeline. A couple clarifications:
- Pilot total is $12,500 (one invoice expected at completion).
- LatticeWorks can route the signed SOW and W-9 now — attaching again in case it did not come through first time.
- If the pilot converts we will expedite PO creation; if not, this is a single final invoice.

Please let me know the name/email to send the invoice and any vendor code once created. We prefer net-30 if possible.

Thanks — Evan

Attachment: latticeworks_w9.pdf

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 21 Jun 2028 08:05:00 -0700

Priya / Karthik — forwarding the vendor materials and vendor ask. Summary below (internal):

Summary: LatticeWorks requests invoice-only onboarding for a time-boxed pilot (single invoice $12.5k). W-9 + signed SOW attached. They will create a PO if the pilot converts to a larger deal (deal id: DW-8291).

Risk/controls suggested:
- Limit exception to pilot dates (start 2028-06-26, end 2028-07-17).
- Require invoice be sent to procurement-invoices@redwood.com with SOW ID in description.
- Finance to hold payment until vendor setup verification; require a business justification note in the vendor record.

Question: Can finance approve a temporary invoice-only entry for LatticeWorks and set net-30 for this invoice? If yes, please confirm the vendor code and any additional docs required (banking info, W-9 already provided).

Naomi / Karthik — reviewed and approve with controls.

Approval details:
- Finance approves invoice-only onboarding for this single pilot invoice up to $15,000.
- Net terms: Net-30 approved.
- Vendor setup: Procurement will create a temporary vendor record; vendor code: V-10244.
- Invoicing instructions (communicate to LatticeWorks): send invoice to procurement-invoices@redwood.com and cc priya@redwood.ai; include SOW ID and "Pilot DW-8291" in invoice memo.
- Conditions: This exception expires automatically on 2028-07-31 unless a PO is issued before then. If the pilot converts to a longer engagement, procurement will open a PO and update the vendor record.

Attachments required to close: W-9 (received), signed SOW (received). Please confirm when vendor is in the system and share vendor code so Evan can send invoice.

I'll also create a short entry in Jira (PROC-4821) documenting the exception and controls.

Priya Natarajan

- Approved: single pilot invoice up to $15,000, Net-30.
- Vendor code: V-10244 (procurement will finalize vendor record).
- Invoice address: procurement-invoices@redwood.com. Please cc priya@redwood.ai and include "Pilot DW-8291" and SOW ID on the invoice.
